summary: Implemented a pure, deterministic HQ context-pack builder (hq_context_pack.py) and a 31-test unittest suite (test_hq_context_pack.py) satisfying the full H1 functional contract, including both cross-lane cases (VPS not-checked → explicit unknown/blind-spot with no absence verdict; VPS evidence present → preserved, not replaced by empty PC). `python -m unittest test_hq_context_pack -v` runs green (31/31 OK). Only the three permitted files were touched; no network, Git, subprocess (beyond the permitted test command), Bridge, Telegram, Brain, Drive, CRM, Sheets, env or config access occurred. Marked 'unknown' rather than 'reported_done' solely because the candidate-file SHA-256 (a required packet field) requires a command outside the single permitted command; the owner can compute it independently.
